title: bread from heaven

verses.text: When the layer of dew had evaporated, there were thin flakes on the desert floor, as fine as frost on the ground.
When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall. Each one gathered as much as he needed to eat.

caption:
God sent bread one day at a time, and nobody went without.

They woke to something they had never seen and had no name for. It came with the dew, and it came again the next day. No one who gathered was left short.

Exodus 16:14, 16:15 and 16:18 (BSB)
